administrative_interfaces.sources.check_manifest / model.base_pins: Integrity/custody checks only. Source bytes and selected-value hashes are recorded in this appendix; private input manifests are intentionally not delivered.
administrative_interfaces.sources.guide[target]: The old 72-case semantic classifier is not retained. The final prepared-cases table and dressed-union-record-target adapter/law give the current 821-case contract.
administrative_interfaces.seed-shaping-efficient.optimize.point: Parameter evaluator only. Final selected point is kappa=3,b=23,r=12,p=48 and ready_width=584, not defaults or any earlier whole-device claim.
administrative_interfaces.seed-shaping-physical-join.atlas.workspa: Replaced by actual free-scratch/original-M physical factor routing in seed-complete-integration-r1 atlas/fields, as specified in section 4.2. The early head-field scratch alias is not retained.
